units.density_per_10k_km2_yr: regional event-day density, NOT a facility-specific strike rate
units.tornado_strike_prob_per_yr: annual probability the facility point is inside a tornado damage path

reporting_bias: NOT fully controlled. Significant hail and wind report counts rise ~24-26% per decade even within the modern era, and residual bias correlates with population density. Only EF2+ tornado is approximately stationary.

tornado.strike_estimator: path-area (Thom/Schaefer): sum of track length x width intersecting the disc, divided by disc area and years
